title: Event envelope v1
description: Common envelope of every domain event published by the four services (Session 1). Proposed contract: no publisher exists yet. The fields follow the event rules in Docs 02-domain/domain-events.md: every tenant-scoped event carries the tenant, the actor, the occurrence time and the affected aggregate.

eventId.description: Unique per published event. Consumers deduplicate on it (see Session 1, idempotent consumer).

eventType.description: Event name from the domain event catalog, e.g. PaymentValidated.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR version of the schema of this eventType.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. A string in the monolith, not a UUID.

aggregateId.description: Id of the affected aggregate; also the routing key, so events of one aggregate stay ordered. The reservation id for reservation events.

actor.description: Reference of the actor that caused the fact.

payload.description: Event-specific data, defined by each event schema.
